description: A minimal HTTP client using libwebsockets secure streams API to fetch files over HTTPS and save them to the local filesystem. The code demonstrates establishing multiple concurrent secure stream downloads, handling signals, and managing callback states.

classes.name: lssFile
classes.description: A class representing a secure stream file download, responsible for handling positions, completion, and callbacks.

methods.name: lss_completion
methods.description: Callback invoked upon stream completion, logs results, and manages program flow.

methods.name: sigint_handler
methods.description: Handles SIGINT signal to terminate the program loop.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that initializes the context, starts concurrent downloads, and runs the event loop.
